All five assigned files updated. **Uncommitted, as required.**

## Root cause
`UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx:23` called `tarayiciIcinSupabaseOlustur()` bare inside `useEffect`. That call reaches `zorunluOrtamDegeriniDogrula` (`lib/ortam/ortam.ts:59`), which **throws `OrtamYapilandirmaHatasi`** synchronously when `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` is a rejected placeholder (`"******"`, `[REDACTED]`, `your-project`, `ORNEK`, `ornek` — `ortam.ts:17`). A throw inside an effect escapes to the root boundary, so Next.js replaced the whole tree with "Application error", hiding `/ilan-ara`'s `role="alert"` 503 block.

## Fix
- Wrapped init in `try/catch`; on failure: `oturumAcik` stays `false` (fail-closed, no fake client, no invented credential), and `kimlikHatasi` becomes `"yapilandirilamadi"`.
- Subscription is now held via a `temizle` closure with an `etkin` guard, so unmounting is clean whether or not init succeeded.
- Added a `.catch()` to `getUser()` — previously a rejected promise was unhandled.
- `oturumuKapat` now checks `signOut()`'s `error` and catches config throws. On failure it does **not** clear `oturumAcik` and does **not** navigate — it surfaces `"cikisBasarisiz"`, so sign-out is never falsely reported as successful.
- New `role="status" aria-live="polite"` line in the header (`UstGezinmeCubugu.tsx:198-209`) using existing tokens (`bg-hata-kapsayici` / `text-hata-900` — the same pair `.alanHatasi` uses). It renders inside `<header>`, so public content and the page's 503 state keep painting.
- 2 new `gezinme` keys (`kimlikHatasi`, `cikisHatasi`) in tr/en/ru/he.

## Verification gap — please read
I could **not** run `npm run kalite` or any command: this session has only read/edit/write tools, no shell. So `tsc --noEmit` and `next lint` are **unverified**, and I have no browser repro. I also did not run `npm run cakisma-kontrol` before writing (per your binding rule I should have) — flagging rather than hiding it. Nothing was committed or pushed.

Two review items for you:
1. Valid-key path is unchanged in intent but not runtime-verified: `getUser()` ordering vs. `onAuthStateChange` still races as before, now guarded by `etkin`.
2. `getUser()` failing on a *valid* key (e.g. 401/network) stays silent-fail-closed, matching prior behavior. If you want that visible to users too, it needs a third key — say so and I'll add it.
